offlineProtection.explainerLead: During service you must keep the dashboard or the kitchen screen on and online.
offlineProtection.explainerBody: If the screen goes off, the device loses internet or you switch to another website, offline protection steps in — it either pauses orders or turns off auto-accept, as you chose.
offlineProtection.reminder: ⚠️ During service keep the dashboard or the kitchen screen on and online, otherwise offline protection may step in.
offlineProtection.enableConfirm:
Offline protection was enabled.

For orders to keep coming, the screen must stay on. If this device loses connection, offline protection steps in according to the mode you chose.

Make sure “Screen on” is active on this device.
offlineProtection.disableConfirm:
Disable offline protection for this event?

If this device loses connection, online orders will continue — customers may place orders that you do not see. Disable it only if you have a stable connection.
offlineProtection.cardDescription: Decides what happens to the orders that arrive when your device goes offline.
offlineProtection.purpose: If your device loses connection, this stops orders arriving while you cannot see them.
offlineProtection.switchHelp: What happens when this van loses connection.
offlineProtection.modes.pause.label: Pause online orders
offlineProtection.modes.pause.help: Customers cannot order until you are online again.
offlineProtection.modes.no_auto_accept.l: Keep taking orders, confirm them yourself
offlineProtection.modes.no_auto_accept.h: Auto-accept is turned off, so customers can still order but nothing is confirmed automatically. You confirm each one when you are online again — and any order still pending is rejected automatically after the time you chose, and the customer is notified by email.
kitchenCapacity.desc: The largest number of items your kitchen can turn out at once, across all the categories you ticked. Each category’s batch size still applies on top.
kitchenCapacity.example: Example: if you can cook 4 mains in 5 minutes, set it to 4 items every 5 minutes. Total capacity limits orders across all the selected categories, so if you want to sell at most 10 starters and mains every 5 minutes, set Total capacity to 10 items every 5 minutes and tick the Starters and Mains boxes. That way mains still stay limited to 4 items every 5 minutes.
kitchenCapacity.noLimit: Leave it at the infinity symbol to leave it without a limit.
kitchenCapacity.warning: ⚠️ For kitchen capacity to work properly, set the prep time and the batch size on the menu categories (Menu and stock). Without them, capacity does not know how long items take to cook.

settingsCopy.allowCancellation.label: Let customers cancel orders
settingsCopy.allowCancellation.sentence: Customers can cancel up to <select></select> before the collection time
settingsCopy.autoAccept.label: Accept orders automatically
settingsCopy.autoAccept.help: Orders confirm automatically. If the requested slot is full, the order moves to the first free slot. It confirms only when there is capacity. Orders with customer notes (e.g. an allergy) still need to be confirmed.
settingsCopy.orderReady.label: The “Order ready” step
settingsCopy.orderReady.help: Shows a “Mark as ready” button on the orders screen. Kitchen screens are set separately, on each device. Customers get an email whenever an order is marked ready. Applies to all events — you can still turn it on or off for a single event from its dashboard.
settingsCopy.buzzers.label: Do you give customers buzzers for collecting the order?
settingsCopy.buzzers.help: Record which buzzer you gave each customer, so you know whom to look for when their food is ready.
